regions.today: Dry and sunny. Cloud will increase through the afternoon with rain spreading from the south as storm Austen tracks to the south of Ireland. Light to moderate southwest winds will back southeast and strengthen about the south coast. Highest temperatures of 11 to 13 degrees.
regions.tonight: Wet and windy weather associated with Storm Austen will bring spells of heavy rain overnight with fresh to strong northeast winds backing northwesterly overnight. Lowest temperatures of 6 to 8 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Wet and windy to start, but the rain will clear eastwards during the morning, giving way to sunshine and scattered showers. Highest temperatures of 8 to 10 degrees in fresh and gusty northwest winds, easing moderate towards the evening.
